units.Haggai 2:1: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the Lord spoke through Haggai the prophet, saying:
units.Haggai 2:2: “Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to all the remnant of the people, saying:
units.Haggai 2:3: Who among you saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? As though it did not exist before you.
units.Haggai 2:4: But now be strong, Zerubbabel, says the Lord; be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; let all the people of the land be strong, says the Lord, and work, for I am with you, says the Lord Almighty,
units.Haggai 2:5: and My Spirit stands in your midst. Take courage.
units.Leviticus 23:33: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
units.Leviticus 23:34: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the Feast of Tents unto the Lord for seven days.
units.Leviticus 23:35: And on the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work.
units.Leviticus 23:36: For seven days you shall bring whole burnt offerings unto the Lord. The eighth day shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall bring whole burnt offerings unto the Lord. It is a closing observance; you shall do no laborious work.
units.Leviticus 23:39: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, when you finish gathering the produce of the land, you shall celebrate unto the Lord for seven days. On the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day there shall be rest.
units.Leviticus 23:40: And on the first day you shall take beautiful fruit of a tree, and palm fronds, and dense branches of a tree, and willows, and branches of the chaste tree from a stream, to rejoice before the Lord your God seven days
units.Leviticus 23:41: of the year. This is an everlasting ordinance throughout your generations; you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
units.Leviticus 23:42: You shall dwell in tents seven days; every native in Israel shall dwell in tents,
units.Leviticus 23:43: so that your generations may see that I made the sons of Israel dwell in tents when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

reread_versions.relationship: Calendar correspondence: month seven, day twenty-one within the Feast of Tents
reread_versions.rationale: Haggai dates the divine message to the twenty-first day of the seventh month. Leviticus sets the Feast of Tents on the fifteenth day of that same month for seven days, followed by an eighth-day closing observance. Counting the fifteenth as the first festival day places the twenty-first on the seventh day of that prescribed calendar. This is a calendar inference from the stated dates, not a claim that Haggai explicitly reports the audience celebrating the feast or calls its date the eighth day.
